summary: Re-tested seller OTP, dashboard, inventory/customer edits, society filters, ordering, delivery status, and mobile layout. Live frontend flows pass, but product availability has no edit control and the status API accepts arbitrary values.

minor.issue: PATCH accepts an arbitrary status such as Cancelled and returns 200; it should restrict values to Pending, Out for Delivery, or Delivered.
PUT does not validate society membership, unlike POST, so direct API callers can persist a society outside the fixed list.

ui_bugs.issue: Product availability is displayed via the status dot but there is no editable availability toggle/control, despite the required product availability action.

action_items: Add an availability control to the product add/edit modal and verify it persists through PUT.
Validate order status against the three supported values and reject invalid values.
Validate customer society on PUT as well as POST.
critical_code_review_comments: The Product model supports available, but FormProduct never renders or submits a user-editable availability field, making that business capability unreachable from the seller UI.

success_rate.frontend: 90% (all exercised flows pass; availability control missing)

seed_data_creation: Regression tests created TEST Update Product and TEST Update Customer; live UI testing updated a product/customer and placed one order. No delete endpoints are available, so these remain in preview MongoDB.
context_for_next_testing_agent: OTP login, dashboard, inventory edit persistence, all six society filters, customer edit persistence, order placement/history, status update, and 390px mobile layout passed. Re-test availability editing and invalid status/society API validation after fixes. Phone SMS OTP is MOCKED: request-otp returns demo_otp 123456 and no SMS provider is connected.
rca of the issue: Availability is present in the backend Product schema and rendered as a dot, but FormProduct only renders name, price, stock, and category. Status validation is absent because update_status accepts a raw query string and writes it directly; customer PUT similarly replaces data without checking SOCIETIES.
